name: Yoga Movement Singapore

brand_voice.summary: Warm, inclusive and community-first. Yoga Movement (YM) makes yoga feel approachable and social: find your flow, find your people. Copy is simple, human and upbeat, and treats movement as part of everyday life rather than a spiritual quest.
signature_phrases: Find your flow, find your people
Already know you'll be back on the mat?
Make your next pack go further
Bring a friend, bring a few, or bring the whole crew
rules: Yoga Movement can be shortened to YM after the first mention, or used alone in short headlines.
The branded merch is written "YM MVMT Kit".
Class names are written with a colon: "Flow: Pace", "Flow: Build", "Flow: Power", and "BASE" in capitals.
Class packs are shareable with unlimited friends. Mention it when the offer is a class pack and sharing is relevant.
Bigger packs and memberships speak to people who already practise (retention), not only beginners.
avoid: Overly spiritual or vague clichés (namaste vibes, unlock your inner self)
Implying the viewer is inflexible, unfit or stressed (Meta personal attributes policy)

Flow: Build isolates a specific peak pose, transition, or movement pattern so you can approach it safely and confidently.
